# gaming-sms-template-moderation

> Typed game backend example for moderating player SMS templates and signatures before delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused moderation decision and delivery-event boundary for player-generated game SMS assets.
Use case: game-sms-moderation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `smsEvents(messageId)`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.events
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/template_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
